Additional comments:

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: We got different instuctions and this could have been made better

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: A representative and older students

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Succesful

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Look closely at the timescedules and ask the faculty if they are not available before you need to sign up. I ended up starting my courses in mid october meaning my courses were all peaking at the same time

questions.answer: Yes

questions.answer: Acces to nature, and embracing the light and darkness

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: It is expensive to live here, plan a lot of trips to the surrounding areas and join the sportclubs

questions.answer: The housing situation, that we should not rely on Samskipnaden

questions.answer: To live in the Arctic environment both in the summer times and the winter times
